assessment: The study provides a valuable showcase of a workflow to perform large-scale characterization of drug mechanisms of action using proteomics in which on-target and off-targets of 166 compounds using proteome solubility analysis in living cells and cell lysates were determined. The evidence supporting the claims of the authors is solid, however, the inclusion of more replicate experiments and more statistical rigor would have strengthened the study. This will be of broad interest to medicinal chemists, toxicologists, computational biologists and biochemists.
